definitions.explanation: Showing a striking difference when compared. Used to describe two things that are markedly different from each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{対照的|たいしょうてき}だ。
⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{妹|いもうと}→妹：00573_imouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{対照的|たいしょうてき}な⟦{生|い}き{方|かた}→生き方：10014_ikikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The older and younger sisters lead contrasting lifestyles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{喧騒|けんそう}→喧騒：16870_kensou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{対照的|たいしょうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧で⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧だ。
examples.english: In contrast to the hustle and bustle of the city, this village is quiet and peaceful.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{対照的|たいしょうてき} can be used as a na-adjective modifier ({対照的|たいしょうてき}な) or with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ as an adverb ({対照的|たいしょうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, meaning "in contrast"). It often appears in the pattern A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{対照的|たいしょうてき}だ (A and B are contrasting).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対照的|たいしょうてき}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ — contrasting personalities
- X⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{対照的|たいしょうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — in contrast to X
- {対照的|たいしょうてき}な⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ — contrasting results
- きわめて{対照的|たいしょうてき}だ — to be in stark contrast

SIMILAR WORDS:
The base noun ⟦{対照|たいしょう}→対照：03394_taishou⟧ means contrast or comparison. ⟦{対比|たいひ}→対比：12417_taihi⟧ also means contrast but is used as a noun/suru verb. ⟦{正反対|せいはんたい}→正反対：14724_seihantai⟧ means the exact opposite, which is stronger than {対照的|たいしょうてき}.
